Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: VAT handling and invoice locale for EU deliveries

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the context. Quick checklist from finance/tax for De Sanctis:

1) VAT treatment
- If Redwood is purchasing into an EU-registered Redwood entity and provides a valid EU VAT number, De Sanctis should issue a VAT-exempt invoice using the reverse-charge mechanism (zero VAT on the invoice, include reference: "Reverse charge — Article 44/196 of the VAT Directive; buyer VAT: <Redwood VAT>").
- If Redwood entity is non-EU or does not provide a VAT ID, the vendor should charge the appropriate Italian VAT (22%).

2) Invoice content required for PO match
- Seller legal name and VAT (as on certificate)
- Invoice number and issue date
- PO number (Redwood PO) listed on the first page
- Line-item descriptions in English (short translation next to Italian description is fine)
- Currency clearly stated (EUR) and IBAN + SWIFT for payment
- Total net amount, VAT amount (if charged), and grand total

3) File format & translations
- PDF is preferred. If De Sanctis issues nota fiscale XML, please also provide a one-page PDF summary in English for our AP queue.

4) Banking & KYC
- IBAN + SWIFT accepted. For larger invoices we may require a bank confirmation letter (we'll ask if payment > EUR 50k).

5) Next steps for onboarding form
- Once Jonas receives the completed vendor form, procurement will open the vendor in our ERP and create a test PO. Laura, please create a small EUR test PO (<= EUR 500) to validate invoice ingestion.

Attachments to request from vendor: signed vendor onboarding form, VAT certificate (already received — good), English PDF invoice summary.

If vendor prefers to charge VAT while we validate the VAT ID, we can accept but will request a credit note if reverse-charge should have applied.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Ben confirmed the tax path. Short plan to keep things moving:

3) Provide a one-page English PDF summary of your nota fiscale alongside the Italian version for faster PO matching.
4) We will create a EUR test PO (<= EUR 500) once the form is returned; expect payment terms per contract after successful ingestion.
